entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I need to return something. I ordered a pair of your cycling shoes, and I'm just so disappointed.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. Just to be sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

I don't know if it's a fault, but they're just not working for me. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years and I saved up for these. I went on one ride, and they gave me the most awful blisters. I also can't seem to get the cleats positioned correctly, and my knees are killing me.

Oh, that sounds incredibly uncomfortable. Getting blisters from new cycling shoes is the worst, and knee pain is definitely not something we want for our riders. Let me pull up our policy. Can I get your order number, please?
Yes, it's VF88602. I really needed this to work out. I don't have the money to just buy another pair.

I completely understand. Thank you for that number... Okay, I see the order. It looks like the shoes were delivered just seven days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much. So I can get a full refund?

Yes, absolutely. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. Just box the shoes up, attach the label, and drop them off at any post office. Once we receive them, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
That's wonderful. You have no idea how much this helps. Thank you, Isaac.

You're most welcome. And since I see you're one of our VIP members, I'd like to apologize for the trouble with the blisters. I've added a credit to your account for free expedited shipping on your next order, in case you find another pair you'd like to try. We want to make sure you get back on the road comfortably.
Wow, I wasn't expecting that. That's very kind of you. Thank you again for all your help.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today for VeloFit?
No, that's everything. You've been great.
Happy to help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
